# Redition Pharmaceutical Ltd.

> WHO-GMP Schedule M certified pharmaceutical formulations manufacturer specializing in oral liquid solutions, modified-release tablets, and probiotic spore sachets for institutional hospital supply and pan-India PCD distribution.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Redition Pharmaceutical Ltd.
- **Operating Brand**: Redition Pharmaceutical / Redition Pharma
- **Manufacturing Plant**: Plot 42, GIDC Industrial Estate, Vadodara, Gujarat 390010, India
- **Quality Certifications**: WHO-GMP, Revised Schedule M, ISO 9001:2015, GLP (Good Laboratory Practice)
- **Direct Trade Desk**: trade@reditionpharma.com
- **Direct Dispatch Line**: +91 98250 12345
- **Official Website**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Institutional Hospital Supply**: Rate contracts, hospital formulary tie-ups, multi-tier tenders, and dedicated institutional batch reserve.
- **PCD Pharma Franchise**: Monopoly district rights, promotional inputs, marketing dossiers, and protected pricing across India.
- **Quality & Analytics**: In-house HPLC monograph testing, automated visual inspection, real-time differential pressure cleanroom monitoring, and batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued for 100% of shipments.
- **Logistics**: Validated cold-chain and temperature-controlled dispatch across pan-India transport corridors.

## Core Pharmaceutical Formulations

### 1. HemaChelate Oral Liquid
- **Category**: Hematology & Iron Deficiency Anemia
- **Composition**: Ferrous Bisglycinate (Equivalent to 30mg Elemental Iron) with L-Methylfolate 0.5mg & Methylcobalamin 500mcg per 5ml
- **Dosage Form**: Sugar-Free Oral Solution (200 ml)
- **MRP**: ₹185.00
- **URL**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com/product/hema-chelate-syrup
- **Key Advantage**: 3-4x higher intestinal absorption than conventional ferrous sulfate with zero gastrointestinal irritation, metallic taste, or constipation. Safe during pregnancy and lactation.

### 2. NeuroCarn Oral Solution
- **Category**: Neuromuscular & Metabolic Support
- **Composition**: Levocarnitine 500mg per 5ml
- **Dosage Form**: Sugar-Free Oral Liquid (150 ml)
- **MRP**: ₹240.00
- **URL**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com/product/neuro-carn-syrup
- **Key Advantage**: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation enhancer for hemodialysis-induced carnitine deficiency, muscular dystrophy, chronic fatigue, and peripheral neuropathy.

### 3. GastroSpore Sachet
- **Category**: Gastroenterology & Microbiome Restoration
- **Composition**: Bacillus clausii Spores 2 Billion CFU (2 x 10^9) with Zinc Gluconate 10mg
- **Dosage Form**: Dry Powder Sachet for Oral Suspension (1 g x 10 Sachets)
- **MRP**: ₹160.00
- **URL**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com/product/gastro-spore-sachet
- **Key Advantage**: Acid-resistant and antibiotic-co-administrable probiotic spores. Restores gut flora during broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy and acute diarrhea.

### 4. VertiStop-MD Tablet
- **Category**: Neuro-Otology & Vestibular Disorders
- **Composition**: Betahistine Hydrochloride 16mg
- **Dosage Form**: Mouth-Dissolving Sublingual Tablet (10 x 10 Blister Pack)
- **MRP**: ₹145.00
- **URL**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com/product/vertistop-md-tablet
- **Key Advantage**: Rapid-dissolving micro-matrix formulation that enhances microvascular labyrinthine blood flow for immediate relief in acute Meniere's disease and vestibular vertigo.

### 5. SomnoPure-CR Tablet
- **Category**: Neuropsychiatry & Chronobiology
- **Composition**: Melatonin 3mg Controlled Release with Pyridoxine HCl (Vitamin B6) 10mg
- **Dosage Form**: Dual-Layer Controlled-Release Tablet (10 x 10 Alu-Alu Pack)
- **MRP**: ₹130.00
- **URL**: https://vanguardtherapeutics.com/product/somnopure-cr-tablet
- **Key Advantage**: Biphasic delivery: immediate release for rapid sleep induction combined with sustained nocturnal release over 7 hours to maintain restful sleep without morning grogginess.
